localTips.title: Watch your "meses sin intereses"
localTips.why: Interest-free instalments feel free, but several at once tie up future quincenas and push people into paying only the card minimum, where interest is around 55% a year.
tips: Add up every MSI instalment still running before buying anything new on instalments.
Keep MSI payments to a small share of each quincena and never pay just the minimum.
Ask for the cash price; some shops give a discount that MSI hides.

pct.note: Estimate; not from a cited study

localTips.title: Stay out of the DAC tariff
localTips.why: CFE moves high-use homes to the unsubsidised DAC tariff based on 12 months of use, and getting out takes a year of lower use. Each block above basic use also costs more per kWh.
tips: Check the "Tarifa" line and kWh blocks on your CFE bill.
Run the AC at 25–26°C, and replace fridges and AC units over 10 years old with efficient models.
Move ironing, washing and pumps out of the hottest hours.

pct.note: Estimate; matches the existing slab rule

localTips.title: Make each gas cylinder last longer
localTips.why: Gas LP prices are capped weekly, but a family can go through one or two cylinders a month.
tips: Check the weekly maximum price per kg for your area before you pay the delivery.
Look for leaks with soapy water on the hose and regulator.
Use lids on pots and a solar or efficient water heater if you can.

pct.note: Estimate; not from a cited study
